title: Martyr!
author: Kaveh Akbar
engineRationale: Martyr! is carried by specific, nameable characters (Cyrus Shams, his mother Roya/Orkideh, father Ali, uncle Arash) and real documentary scenes — the Iran Air Flight 655 shootdown, the Brooklyn Museum death-exhibit, the Iran-Iraq war 'angel of death' — all of which suit photoreal Flux cut-outs of period/figure imagery far better than an abstract everyman vector rig.
